verses.saheeh: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?
verses.khattab: Has the news of the Overwhelming Event reached you ˹O Prophet˺
verses.jalalayn: Has there — [there has] indeed — come to you the tiding of the Enveloper?, the Resurrection, [so called] because it ‘envelops’ creatures with its terrors.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya tumhein us chaa janey wali aafat ki khabar pahunchi hai

verses.saheeh: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,
verses.khattab: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be downcast
verses.jalalayn: Some faces on that day — they [faces] are used to represent the individuals in both instances — will be humbled, abject,
verses.romanUrdu: Kuch chehrey us roz khauff zada hongey

verses.saheeh: Working [hard] and exhausted.
verses.khattab: ˹totally˺ overburdened, exhausted
verses.jalalayn: toiling, weary, tired and exhausted from the chains and fetters,
verses.romanUrdu: Sakht mashakkat kar rahe hongey

verses.saheeh: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.
verses.khattab: burning in a scorching Fire
verses.jalalayn: roasting (read taslā or tuslā) in a scorching fire,
verses.romanUrdu: Thakey jatey hongey, shadeed aag mei jhulas rahe hongey

verses.saheeh: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.
verses.khattab: left to drink from a scalding spring
verses.jalalayn: made to drink from a boiling spring, one of extremely hot temperatures.
verses.romanUrdu: khaultey(boiling) huey chashmey(spring) ka paani unhei peene ko diya jaeyga

wbw.translation: They will be given to drink

verses.uthmani: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍۢ
verses.indopak: لَـيۡسَ لَهُمۡ طَعَامٌ اِلَّا مِنۡ ضَرِيۡعٍ ۙ
verses.transliteration: Laisa lahum ta'aamun illaa min daree'
verses.saheeh: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
verses.khattab: They will have no food except a foul, thorny shrub
verses.jalalayn: They will have no food except cactus (darī‘) — a type of thorn plant which no animal grazes on because of its vileness —
verses.romanUrdu: khar-dar(kaante-daar) sukhi ghaans ke siwa koi khana unke liye na hoga

verses.uthmani: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍۢ
verses.indopak: لَّا يُسۡمِنُ وَلَا يُغۡنِىۡ مِنۡ جُوۡعٍ ؕ
verses.transliteration: Laa yusminu wa laa yughnee min joo'
verses.saheeh: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.
verses.khattab: neither nourishing nor satisfying hunger
verses.jalalayn: neither nourishing, nor availing against hunger.
verses.romanUrdu: Jo na mota karey na bhook mitaye

verses.saheeh: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.
verses.khattab: On that Day ˹other˺ faces will be glowing with bliss
verses.jalalayn: Other faces on that day will be delicate, fair,
verses.romanUrdu: kuch chehrey us roz ba-raunak hongey

verses.saheeh: With their effort [they are] satisfied
verses.khattab: ˹fully˺ pleased with their striving
verses.jalalayn: pleased by their efforts, in the [life of the] world [expended] in obedience, [pleased] in the Hereafter upon seeing the reward thereof;
verses.romanUrdu: Apne kar-guzari par khush hongey

verses.saheeh: In an elevated garden,
verses.khattab: in an elevated Garden
verses.jalalayn: in a lofty Garden, [lofty] in a physical as well as an abstract sense,
verses.romanUrdu: Aali muqaam jannat mein hongey

verses.saheeh: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.
verses.khattab: where no idle talk will be heard
verses.jalalayn: in which they will not hear (read lā yusma‘u, ‘will not be heard’, or lā tasma‘u, ‘they will not hear’) any vanity, any inane soul, speaking drivel;
verses.romanUrdu: koi behuda baat wahan na sunengey

verses.saheeh: Within it is a flowing spring.
verses.khattab: In it will be a running spring
verses.jalalayn: therein is a running spring, of water, meaning ‘springs’;
verses.romanUrdu: Usmein chasmey rawan hongey

verses.saheeh: Within it are couches raised high
verses.khattab: along with thrones raised high
verses.jalalayn: therein are lofty couches, [lofty] in terms of their essence, their size and [physical] location,
verses.romanUrdu: Uske andar unchi masnadein hongi

verses.saheeh: And cups put in place
verses.khattab: and cups set at hand
verses.jalalayn: and goblets, vessels without handles, set, around the edges of the springs prepared for them to drink with,
verses.romanUrdu: Sagar rakhey huey hongey

verses.saheeh: And cushions lined up
verses.khattab: and ˹fine˺ cushions lined up
verses.jalalayn: and cushions arrayed, one next to the other, against which they may lean,
verses.romanUrdu: gaon takiyon(cushions arrayed) ke qatarein lagi hongi

verses.saheeh: And carpets spread around.
verses.khattab: and ˹splendid˺ carpets spread out
verses.jalalayn: and carpets, rugs of velvet-hair, spread out.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur nafees farsh bichey huey hongey

verses.uthmani: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
verses.indopak: اَفَلَا يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَى الۡاِ بِلِ كَيۡفَ خُلِقَتۡ
verses.saheeh: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
verses.khattab: Do they not ever reflect on camels—how they were ˹masterfully˺ created
verses.jalalayn: Will they, the Meccan disbelievers, not consider, by way of reflection, the camels, how they are created?
verses.romanUrdu: (yeh log nahin mantey) to kya yeh unton ko nahin dekhtey ke kaisey banaye gaye

verses.saheeh: And at the sky - how it is raised?
verses.khattab: and the sky—how it was raised ˹high˺
verses.jalalayn: And the heaven, how it was raised?
verses.romanUrdu: Asman ko nahin dekhte ke kaise uthaya gaya

verses.saheeh: And at the mountains - how they are erected?
verses.khattab: and the mountains—how they were firmly set up
verses.jalalayn: And the mountains, how they were set?
verses.romanUrdu: Pahadon ko nahin dekhtey ke kaisey jamaye gaye

verses.saheeh: And at the earth - how it is spread out?
verses.khattab: and the earth—how it was levelled out
verses.jalalayn: And the earth, how it was laid out flat?, and thus infer from this the power of God, exalted be He, and His Oneness? The commencing with the [mention of] camels is because they are closer in contact with it [the earth] than any other [animal]. As for His words sutihat, ‘laid out flat’, this on a literal reading suggests that the earth is flat, which is the opinion of most of the scholars of the [revealed] Law, and not a sphere as astronomers (ahl al-hay’a) have it, even if this [latter] does not contradict any of the pillars of the Law.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur zameen ko nahin dekhtey ke kaisey bichayi gayi

verses.saheeh: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.
verses.khattab: So, ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O Prophet˺, for your duty is only to remind
verses.jalalayn: So remind, them of God’s graces and the proofs affirming His Oneness. For you are only an admonisher;
verses.romanUrdu: Acha to ( aey nabi) nasihat kiye jao, tum bas nasihat hi karne wale ho

verses.saheeh: You are not over them a controller.
verses.khattab: You are not ˹there˺ to compel them ˹to believe˺
verses.jalalayn: you are not a taskmaster over them (a variant reading [for musaytir] has musaytir, that is to say, [not one who has been] given authority over them) — this was [revealed] before the command to struggle [against the disbelievers].
verses.romanUrdu: kuch inpar jabr karne wale nahin ho

verses.saheeh: However, he who turns away and disbelieves -
verses.khattab: But whoever turns away, persisting in disbelief
verses.jalalayn: But he who turns away, [he who] rejects faith, and disbelieves, in the Qur'an,
verses.romanUrdu: Albatta jo shaks mooh modega aur inkar karega

verses.saheeh: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.
verses.khattab: then Allah will inflict upon them the major punishment
verses.jalalayn: God will chastise him with the greater chastisement, the chastisement of the Hereafter, the lesser chastisement being that of this world, that of being killed or taken captive.
verses.romanUrdu: To Allah usko bhaari saza dega

verses.saheeh: Indeed, to Us is their return.
verses.khattab: Surely to Us is their return
verses.jalalayn: Truly to Us will be their return, their coming back after death,
verses.romanUrdu: In logon ko palatna hamari taraf hi hai

verses.saheeh: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
verses.khattab: then surely with Us is their reckoning
verses.jalalayn: then truly with Us will lie their reckoning, their requital, which We will never abandon.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir inka hisab lena hamare hi zimmey hai
